title: Microsoft Purview: retention based on last accessed date for SharePoint and OneDrive files (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Pass: the roadmap facts, existing retention controls and licensing background are supported, and targeted searches confirmed the stated gaps for last-accessed retention. The policy wizard path needs a minor extension to reach the retention settings. Directions in the historical verifier comment were ignored and its findings checked independently.

claims.claim: SharePoint and OneDrive retention uses the Preservation Hold library to preserve content.
claims.quote: But if they edit or delete content that's included in the retention policy, a copy of the content is automatically retained. ... For SharePoint and OneDrive sites: The copy is retained in the Preservation Hold library.

claims.quote: Because the Preservation Hold library is included in the site's storage quota, you might need to increase your storage when you use retention settings for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 groups.

claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and the rendered path to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both'.
